description.narrative: The Programme for Country Partnership (PCP) Zambia will support the Government of the Republic of Zambia in the implementation of its Vision 2030 and the Eighth National Development Plan (8NDP). The Programme#s objective and targeted results have built upon the lessons learned in the implementation of the Seventh National Development Plan (7NDP) and have been well aligned with the relevant national policy framework, and notably with the National Industrial Policy 2018. The Programme will also serve as the main framework of action for UNIDO to contribute to the implementation of the United Nations Strategic Development Partnership Framework (UNSDPF) 2016-2022 for Zambia and its Addendum as well as the UN Socio-Economic Response Plan guiding the UN efforts to facilitate the post-COVID-19 recovery in the country.
